title: Decision Band
prompt: Use case: UI mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for the mobile-first Nudge training web app. Primary request: design composition option 1, "Decision Band," using the committed international-airport-wayfinding visual world. Render a straight-on 390x844 portrait app viewport with no device bezel, no hands, and no surrounding scene. This is a real designed app surface, not a poster or airport scene. Structure in order: compact black shared shell with Nudge wordmark and a quiet Catalog exit; a slim route strip labeled Plan / Performance / Cooldown / Review with Performance current; a white working field dominated by "Dumbbell bench press" and monumental "02" for exercise 2, with "Set 2 of 3" and editable 95 lb / 8 reps controls; a black inset status pictogram; a concurrent-rest strip showing "Bench rest 1:12" while "Shoulder press" is available next; one full-width saturated-yellow edge-to-edge action band at the bottom labeled "Start set" with an edge-locked arrow; quiet agency links "Change exercise" and "Finish workout" remain visible but subordinate. Show enough of the route and concurrent rest to prove Plan through Review orientation. Style: airport yellow #FFCC00, jet black #0D0D0D, signal white, graphite and concrete neutrals; bold humanist sans similar to Frutiger, monumental tabular numerals, strict rules, inset black pictograms, matte enamel panels, precise 2px black borders, generous touch targets. No rounded-card dashboard, no gradients, no glow, no glass, no photography, no planes, no airport labels, no bottom navigation invention, no trophies, streaks, praise, readiness score, scientific claims, urgency, guilt, coaching voice, or invented recommendation. Keep standard form controls recognizable, visible focus treatment, and state understandable without color. Synthetic workout content only. No watermark.
